hooks.command: r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; d="$r/vault"; [ -d "$d/.git" ] && git -C "$d" pull --rebase --autostash -q > /dev/null 2>&1; [ -f "$d/USER.md" ] && { echo 'vault/USER.md, who the user is and their goals:'; cat "$d/USER.md"; echo; }; [ -f "$d/index.md" ] && { echo 'vault/index.md, the vault recall surface:'; cat "$d/index.md"; }; [ -x "$r/scripts/sync-project-skills" ] && "$r/scripts/sync-project-skills" > /dev/null 2>&1 && s=$("$r/scripts/sync-project-skills" --summary) && [ -n "$s" ] && { echo; echo "Checkout skills, listed as <checkout>:<skill> once a file in that checkout is read or edited:"; echo "$s"; }; true
